about_the_game:
Take on a challenge from the God of War himself! Jason and Medea embark on Ares’ Arena to uncover the mystery of a stolen artifact. Navigate traps, defeat enemies, and reveal the gods’ secrets. Along the way, discover the Golden Halls, the Forest of Fear, and much more. Test your strength and save the ancient world!

Game Features That Will Make Your Adventure Unforgettable:

- Collector's Edition contains video walkthroughs of the levels

- Immerse Yourself in Greek Myths! A story based on legendary tales that come to life before your eyes!

- Meet New Heroes! Ares and Aphrodite will add vibrant emotions to your journey!

- Music Worthy of the Gods! Epic new tracks for Ares, inspired by Calliope herself, alongside relaxing Greek melodies fit for Aphrodite!

- Expanded Trading Opportunities! Enhanced markets let you trade even more resources.

- A New Storytelling Format! Experience the dynamic plot through comic-style visuals showcasing Jason and Medea’s epic battles against Ares!

- Discover New Mechanics! Under Ares’ watchful eye, face numerous foes in unique challenges.

- Unlock New Locations! Ares’ Arena, bustling trade streets, the Forest of Fear, and vibrant alleys await!

- Updated Graphics! Every game object now feels more immersive and realistic.

- Journey Through Atmospheric Locations! Each level has a unique name that deepens the story.

- Epic Quests! Every mission is crafted to let you dive into Jason and Medea’s legendary adventures!

Test your strategy, speed, and wit! The adventure awaits—are you ready to take on the challenge of the God of War?
